name: Bones of Nu Voledo
source:
Nu Voledo was raised on the bones of another city. Old Voledo sleeps beneath the foundations, a staple of every child's nightmares. It belonged to beings too vast for the word gods to hold, until they brought extinction upon themselves.

Some of them may not be as dead as the city would like.

A gothic eldritch-horror visual novel about orphans, old gods, and the powerful families who trade in both. 

[Edited from [url=https://murigames.itch.io/bones-of-nu-voledo]itch.io[/url]]
